jobs.occupation: Sales & Trade Marketing Manager ( m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.description:
About Stauning

Twenty years ago, nine friends in Stauning — a small village on Denmark's wild west coast — decided to make whisky. Not because Denmark had a whisky tradition, but because they believed Danish grain, Danish water, and Danish design could create something the world hadn't tasted before. They were right.

Today Stauning is Denmark's largest whisky distillery, co-owned by its founders and Diageo, and a Spirits Business Whisky Brand of the Year. We still floor-malt our own locally grown rye and barley and distil over direct fire in small copper pot stills. Germany is one of our most important markets — home to some of the most knowledgeable whisky drinkers in the world, a strong specialist retail scene, and many of our most loyal distillery visitors. We're now looking for someone to take it further.

The role

This is a sales & trade marketing role with a commercial backbone. You will own the day-to-day commercial marketing for the German market: building the annual customer plan for Germany, working alongside our distribution partner, selling into specialist retail and grocery, and ensuring that wherever Stauning shows up in Germany, it shows up well.

You will build channel playbooks with our central marketing team and turn them into sell-in stories, activations, tastings, and visibility that grow distribution and the rate of sale in Germany. Roughly half your time will be spent in the field with customers and our distributor; the rest on planning, activation, and reporting.

The Sales & Trade Marketing Manager will report direct to our Marketing Director, and work closely together with our Area Manager Central Europe

We expect arround 50% Field based and 50% Home Office, North Germany .

Key responsiblities

• 
Support and challenge our German distribution partner — joint business planning, sell-in of new releases and limited editions, target setting, and regular field visits together.

• 
Sell into and grow specialist whisky retail and premium on-trade accounts in major German cities, building lasting relationships with buyers, bartenders, and store owners.

• 
Deliver measurable growth in distribution and rate of sale for our core range and land limited editions with the retailers who love them.

• 
Adapt central brand plans and playbooks into a German commercial calendar — promotions, activations, and launches tailored to the German trade.

• 
Grocery plans and seeding –building seeding and success in targeted independents

• 
Plan and run tastings, masterclasses, and trade events, and represent Stauning at the German trade fairs and whisky festivals that matter.

• 
Ensure brand visibility and effective merchandising — point of sale, staff training, and in-store presence that reflect the way Stauning looks and sounds.

• 
Manage the German trade budget with clear ROI R, and analyse which investments and programmes actually move the needle.

• 
Be the voice of the German market internally — feeding customer insight, competitor activity, and opportunities back to the team in Denmark.

What success looks like

• 
An agreed annual commercial plan for Germany, reviewed regularly with our distributor and key accounts.

• 
Measurable growth in weighted distribution and rate of sale in specialist retail and on-trade.

• 
Strong, consistent trade execution — the brand visible, correct, and well-merchandised across the market.

• 
A trade budget spent deliberately, with clear reporting on what worked.

• 
Feel like part of the distributors team, understanding their business, pain points and working from their office twice per month to create a strong relationship

What are we looking for

• 
Based in Northern Germany – near Bremen / Hamburg.

• 
You have a relevant education.

• 
Experienced in spirits or premium drinks in the North German market — ideally with time on both the sales and trade marketing side.

• 
Well-networked in German specialist retail, grocery and/or premium on-trade, and comfortable opening doors that aren't yet open.

• 
A confident host: happy leading a tasting for thirty buyers or a quiet conversation with one.

• 
Commercially sharp — you read sell-out data, spot what's working, and adjust.

• 
Fluent in German and English.

• 
Willing to travel across North Germany regularly, and to the distillery in Stauning.

• 
Aligned with our values: Passion, Curiosity, Authenticity, Decency, and Financial Responsibility.

What we offer

The chance to build a market for a whisky the world is still discovering, with real ownership and short lines to decision-makers — including the founders. A warm, ambitious team split between Denmark and the markets we serve, competitive terms, and a standing invitation to the west coast of Jutland, where the whisky is made and the wind never quite stops.

Good working conditions.

How to apply

If you are interested in applying for this exciting position, please send your application and CV via the link, in the top right corner: "Apply" for the position.

We process applications on an ongoing basis, so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Marianne Holst Larsen (+45) 40837593 or mail: Marianne@holstlarsen.dk

jobs.occupation: Senior System Consultant, System Services, Netcompany Banking services
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help ensure a great user experience for our customers? In the System Services team at Netcompany Banking Services, we work to support financial institutions in their use of our system solutions. We are looking for a new colleague who can help ensure stable and efficient system usage, ideally with experience in the banking and financial sector, and who can help make complex systems more usable in practice

You will become part of a highly skilled team where collaboration is key. Working closely with colleagues across NBS and System Services, you will help optimize how customers use our solutions. The role covers areas such as process optimization, IT-related tasks, system configuration, and compliance.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities and technologies

In this role, you will help ensure that customers achieve maximum value from NBS core and self-service solutions. This includes system configuration and ongoing adjustments to support customer needs and daily operations.

You will work closely with specialists across NBS, where knowledge sharing is an integrated part of how we work. In your daily work, you will interact with both subject matter experts and senior stakeholders at financial institutions. This requires the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and adapt your messaging to different audiences, with an understanding of the impact on both employees and end customers.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Configuring and optimizing system setups (e.g. products, interest rates, and fees), while providing expert guidance to customers.

• Advising customers and increasing awareness of the NBS product portfolio.

• Facilitating workshops and reviews of customer processes and system usage.

• Analysing current customer setups and needs with a focus on improvements and future solutions.

• Creating process documentation and procedures, delivering training on system usage, and contributing to the implementation and automation of workflows.

About you

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to both experts and senior stakeholders at financial institutions. This requires strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex topics, with an understanding of how decisions impact daily operations and end customers.

You work independently and pragmatically and are motivated by creating value for customers by identifying new opportunities and improvements.

To succeed in this role, you:

• Have an interest in and understanding of banking processes and IT systems.

• Have a few years of experience from a financial institution, preferably in IT support or a similar role.

• Have a good understanding of banking infrastructure.

• Ideally have experience with NBS systems and configuration.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Join an inclusive community

We highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Turnpikes are a consulting company, supporting their existing and new clients with projects and support for their current OpenText Solutions. they help them grow and expand their solutions to provide the highest value for their investment.

About the role

On behalf of Turnpikes, we are looking for an experienced Enterprise Sales Professional. Turnpikes is a fast-growing, global IT consultancy and software reseller that helps global companies work smarter in finance and information management. In this role, you will play a key part in growing Turnpikes' enterprise business across Denmark and the Nordics. You will work with complex projects and some of the market's largest C25 companies.

We do not expect you to have prior knowledge of our primary software, OpenText. Instead, we value your strong "hunter" mentality, your ability to navigate complex enterprise buying processes, and your courage to engage C-level stakeholders. Forget about being boxed in, transactional software sales, and micromanagement – here you get freedom with responsibility, a seat at the table, and the opportunity to make a real impact on the strategy.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a visible impact in a recognized specialist consultancy with ambitious growth plans.

• A unique key role with the freedom to shape strategy, work directly with leadership, and influence how we build the business.

• An attractive commission plan where your success and results translate directly into your own earnings.

• A dynamic work environment based on trust, independence, and ownership – for people who see opportunities where others see complexity.

Work tasks

You will be responsible for identifying, shaping, and winning complex consulting engagements across Denmark and the Nordics. You will build a sustainable pipeline of strategic customers and act as the link between customer needs and our technical teams.

Your tasks will be carried out in a fast-paced environment and will include:

• Develop and hunt: Create new enterprise customers, build strategic relationships, and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

• Engage and advise: Proactively engage with C-level executives and business stakeholders to understand their challenges and identify digital transformation opportunities.

• Shape solutions: Coordinate closely with solution architects and consultants during presales, as well as draft strong commercial proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

• Lead the process: Drive qualification and account strategy from start to finish, including leading commercial negotiations and contract discussions.

• Grow and optimize: Drive growth in existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling, and maintain strict CRM and forecasting discipline.

We are looking for

• Has several years of successful experience in enterprise consulting sales or business development.

• Has a proven track record of selling complex IT consulting, system integration, or digital transformation projects.

• Thrives navigating long end-end enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• Has a strong commercial, analytical, and negotiation-oriented mindset.

• Is a "hunter" with an entrepreneurial spirit, who is also motivated by building and maintaining long-term customer relationships.

• Speaks and writes fluent Danish and masters English at a high level.

It's an advantage if you have

• In-depth understanding of complex enterprise buying processes.

• Experience working closely with technical delivery teams to create winning proposals.

To succeed in the role, your personal competencies are:

• Ambitious

• Relationship-building

• Independent

• Solution-oriented

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Turnpikes ApS

Turnpikes is a fast-moving, global IT consultancy and software reseller. In short: we help companies make their finance and information management work smarter. We work with big-name global companies, complex projects, and clients who expect the best. And we deliver, with a long reference list of current clients who place trust in us. We are proud to have a great variety of C25 companies as long-term reference customers.

Til denne stilling vil du blive ansat direkte af virksomheden. Denne rekrutteringsproces varetages af Academic Work.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen?

Har du spørgsmål, er du mere end velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringsafdelingen på info@academicwork.dk. Angiv venligst opslags-ID'et i din e-mail: KFU35B

Join MoveByBike

Do you enjoy being active instead of sitting behind a desk? Are you looking for flexible part-time work that fits around your studies or other commitments?

MoveByBike is looking for motivated E-Cargo Bike Riders to join our team in Copenhagen as soon as possible.

As an E-Cargo Bike Rider, you'll deliver food products and other goods to businesses and private customers across Copenhagen using our modern electric cargo bikes. Every day is different, and you'll spend your shifts cycling through one of the world's most bike-friendly cities while helping keep Copenhagen moving.

No previous cargo bike experience is required, we provide full training before your first shift.

What you'll do

As part of our operations team, you will:

• 
Deliver goods safely and efficiently using our electric cargo bikes

• 
Load and unload deliveries at our Copenhagen base and customer locations

• 
Follow planned delivery routes throughout the city

• 
Provide friendly and professional service to our customers

• 
Follow safety procedures and traffic regulations

Who we're looking for

This role could be a great fit if you:

• 
Enjoy cycling and being physically active

• 
Like working independently while being part of a supportive team

• 
Are reliable, punctual, and take responsibility for your work

• 
Are comfortable working outdoors throughout the year

• 
Want flexible part-time work alongside your studies or another job

Please note that this is an active outdoor job. You'll spend most of your shift cycling, loading and unloading goods, and working in a variety of weather conditions. If you enjoy staying active and don't mind the Danish weather, you'll likely enjoy working with us.

Requirements

• 
You are at least 18 years old

• 
You currently live in or near Copenhagen

• 
You are legally allowed to work in Denmark (a Danish CPR number is required before employment begins)

• 
You can communicate in English and/or Danish

• 
You are physically fit and able to perform manual work throughout your shift

• 
You are willing to follow schedules, safety procedures, and traffic laws

• 
Previous delivery experience is appreciated, but it is not a requirement

Working hours

• 
Flexible scheduling

• 
Negotiable minimum of hours per week (example: minimum 10 or 20 hours per week)

• 
Availability for at least one Monday shift each week is required, as Mondays are our busiest operating day

• 
Additional shifts available depending on your availability and company needs

• 
Shifts are available on most days between 07:00 and 22:00

Location

Our operational base is located in Nørrebro, which has excellent public transport connections to S-trains, buses and the Metro. It is also easy to reach via bike. All shifts start and end at our base.

What we offer

• 
Starting salary of 135 DKK per hour

• 
Additional pay for Sunday and public holiday shifts

• 
Automatic pay increases after 6 months and again after 12 months

• 
Stable employment with an employment contract. You'll be an employee, not a gig worker.

• 
Flexible scheduling that works around studies or other commitments

• 
Full training before you start

• 
Modern electric cargo bikes provided

• 
Be part of an diverse, friendly, and growing team

• 
Help build a more sustainable Copenhagen through bike-based logistics

Our recruitment process

• 
Submit your application and CV via the provided link.

• 
If your profile matches what we're looking for, we'll invite you to a group interview.

• 
Shortlisted candidates will have the opportunity to test ride one of our electric cargo bikes.

• 
Successful applicants will receive an employment offer and complete onboarding before their first shift.

Ready to join us? Apply today! We are reviewing applications constantly, so do not wait to apply. We are looking forward to know about you.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As a Customer Success Manager, you will own and grow a portfolio of customers by ensuring they realise clear, measurable value from Planday.

In this role, you will be 100% focused on the Norwegian market, turning local customers into long-term partners. You will lead the post-sale customer lifecycle, driving adoption, retention, and account growth through structured account planning, proactive stakeholder engagement, and strong commercial ownership.

You will operate as the trusted partner to your customers, aligning Planday’s capabilities to their business priorities to help them succeed, creating momentum, and identifying opportunities to deepen our relationship and increase the value we deliver.

What you’ll do

• 
Own a portfolio of customers 100% focused on the Norwegian market, with accountability for retention and growth

• 
Build and execute joint account plans with your customers creating clarity on priorities, ownership and where value comes next

• 
Help customers get more from Planday by increasing adoption, confidence, and impact

• 
Lead renewal and commercial conversations with confidence

• 
Lead confident executive conversations about outcomes achieved and what it will take to go further

• 
Build multi-threaded relationships across operational and executive levels

• 
Create and develop opportunities that help customers achieve more with Planday

• 
Partner effectively across Sales, Product, Customer Experience, and Marketing to advance customer priorities

• 
Champion the voice of the customer and influence decisions that make our product stronger

• 
Share customer insight and success patterns that inform internal strategy and planning

What you’ll bring with you

• 
Professional proficiency in the Norwegian market (full native fluency is not required; market proficiency and understanding are key)

• 
Experience managing and growing B2B SaaS customers

• 
Strong commercial instincts and comfort leading value and investment conversations

• 
Proven ability to build joint plans and drive accountability with customers

• 
Confidence engaging executives and navigating complex organisations

• 
Ability to translate product capability into tangible business outcomes

• 
Technical credibility and experience partnering constructively with product teams

• 
High ownership mindset with disciplined follow-through

• 
Collaborative, low-ego approach to winning as a team

Success looks like

• 
Strong retention and expansion across your portfolio through customer relationships that surface upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities.

• 
Customers with active plans and clear progress toward value

• 
Consistent growth in adoption, usage, and realised outcomes

• 
Executive stakeholders who see Planday as a strategic partner and trust you as their adviser

• 
Actionable customer insight shaping internal priorities

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

At Planday, we offer you

• 
Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• 
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• 
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• 
Flexible remote work

• 
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• 
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• 
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

[PE] Our tech stack is cutting edge and our engineering work is supported by dedicated in-house scrum masters and agile evangelists.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

Tinytots International Daycare & Preschool

Tinytots International Daycare & Preschool is an integrated international preschool/ kindergarten in Copenhagen, Denmark, approved by kommunes (municipalities) . We currently have three locations in different parts of the Copenhagen area. Our program is inspired by Highscope and Montessori pedagogical frameworks. Dedicated to providing quality child care, interactive learning and memorable experiences, our preschool program is designed to be different, flexible, and encourage active hands-on learning while introducing age-appropriate academic challenges.

http://www.tinytots.dk/

Kindergarten Educator (Pædagog)

Tinytots International Daycare and Preschool in Copenhagen, Denmark is looking for experienced and enthusiastic Early Childhood Educator.

It is essential that you are a natural team player, a proactive person who takes responsibility and ownership of the tasks and you are flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks.

Responsibilities:

• Planning of activities and lessons and implementation within overall curriculum framework

• Ensure the learning environment is clean, hygienic and safe on continuous basis

• Assist in observation and recording children’s growth, development and behaviour

• Build good, open and constructive communication with children, families, administration and staff

Language, education and experience requirements:

o High level fluency in English (Minimum C1 level; IELTS band 7 and above ) is required. Danish language skill is preferable.

o Bachelors degree in Education / Early Childhood Education is mandatory.

o 2-3 years’ early years teaching experience in Nursery/kindergarten is required.

o Demonstrable experience in Positive Behaviour Management is required.

o Certification in Montessori or equivalent demonstrable experience in implementation of Montessori pedagogy will be an added advantage.

Personal Qualities:

o Creative and truly passionate to work with children while being extremely patient and caring.

o Can engage and extend the children’s learning through play.

o Sound written and verbal communication skills.

o Great team player while can also work independently

o Person who is culturally sensitive and thrives in truly international environment

o Enthusiastic and flexible to share tasks typical for a small but dynamic organisation

Salary and benefits: We offer highly competitive salary, pension and benefits within international childcare sector in Denmark, in accordance with collective agreements.

Work-visa: Work visa can be sponsored for the right candidate (non-EU candidate needs to have Bachelors degree in education / early childhood education to qualify for work visa sponsorship)

Interviews will be conducted as we receive applications. Please note that due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview process.

Join a world of energy as MFT Energy’s new Student Risk Analyst

Are you curious about how risk is managed in one of the fastest-moving industries in the world? At MFT Energy, we are looking for a Student Risk Analyst who wants to gain hands-on experience working with data and risk management in a dynamic energy trading environment.

The role as a Student Risk Analyst:

You will join our Finance, Risk & Treasury department, where you will be part of our Risk team working alongside experienced colleagues with deep industry expertise. The team works closely with stakeholders across the trading organization to provide transparency on the company’s overall risk profile and support informed decision-making.

In a business characterized by rapidly changing market conditions and significant volatility, the Risk team helps ensure a responsible balance between risk and return across all our trading activities.

In this role, you will work with a wide range of datasets, including trade data and market price data that form the foundation of our risk calculations. Through this work, you will contribute to maintaining reliable risk data and develop a strong understanding of how risk management supports a modern energy trading company.

The position offers a steep learning curve in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

Your key responsibilities:

• Working with large trade and market price datasets to ensure the quality of risk calculations

• Developing data quality checks within our in-house data models

• Improving existing tools and developing new solutions (primarily using SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps)

• Automating tasks related to reporting, data processing and analysis

• Supporting the risk business partners with daily ad hoc tasks and analysis

• Gaining exposure to different types of risks including liquidity, market, credit and operational risk

Your qualifications and personal skills:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics or a similar field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and take initiative

• Coding skills are a plus but not required. The most important thing is an interest in learning, as much of the data work will involve SQL

• Interest in energy markets and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Curious and open-minded approach to learning and problem-solving

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center, Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Türkiye, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer:

• A 15–20-hour student position with flexibility to plan your working hours around your studies

• A role where you will take ownership of your tasks while working closely with experienced colleagues who are always ready to support and spar with you

• An international and fast-moving environment where things develop quickly and you will continuously learn new things

• A strong student community and plenty of social activities, such as CrossFit, running club, Friday bars, team events, and more

• A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

Make the most of your talent! Join us!

If you think there is a fit between the role and your aspirations, we will be looking forward to receiving your application with a short cover letter and CV. For questions, please write to career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

Start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER
jobs.description:
International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• 
Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

• 
Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

• 
Quality assurance and photographic documentation

• 
Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

• 
Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

• 
Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

• 
Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

• 
Registering and managing additional works and variations

• 
Participating in construction and project meetings

Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

The ability to communicate in English is important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but Danish does not need to be your native language.

What We Offer

At DK TØMRER, you will become part of a growing company with short decision-making processes and the opportunity to take on significant responsibility.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position involving a variety of construction projects

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

An international workplace that welcomes different nationalities and backgrounds

• 
The opportunity to gain valuable experience in Danish construction management

• 
Close cooperation with company management and our construction organisation

Salary based on qualifications and experience

Work location: Copenhagen and Zealand
Company: DK TØMRER
Starting date: As soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Terminal Worker Wanted for Night Shift in Greve
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on night work, fixed routines, and physical tasks? Then you might be the one we are looking for to join the night shift at a terminal in Greve.

At our client’s terminal in Greve, logistics and distribution of parcels and goods are handled daily. Parcels are received, sorted, and forwarded into the distribution network to ensure they efficiently reach their recipients.

The night shift consists of approximately 20 employees who work closely together in a busy environment. There is a strong team spirit, with colleagues from different backgrounds and levels of experience contributing to a positive and supportive working atmosphere.

The work is routine-based and requires focus and structure. Your tasks will include:

• 
Opening pallets and placing parcels on conveyor belts

• 
Scanning parcels at the sorting line

• 
Sorting parcels into the correct cages according to assigned numbers

• 
Ensuring a stable and efficient sorting flow

The work is performed standing up and is physically demanding. You must be prepared for repeated lifting, frequent movement, and handling parcels that can be quite heavy.

We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic who thrives in physically demanding work and structured routines. You work efficiently and can maintain a steady pace, even during the early morning hours when energy levels are tested. At the same time, you are able to stay focused on repetitive tasks and take initiative if there are pauses in operations, for example by cleaning up or handling other practical tasks. Experience from similar work is an advantage but not a requirement. The most important qualities are reliability, a sense of responsibility, and readiness to take initiative.

You will be employed in a temporary position with the possibility of permanent employment if the match is right and there is an ongoing need. Working hours are typically from 11:00 PM to 6:30 AM, starting Sunday night and finishing the week Saturday morning. The hourly wage is DKK 190.96 in accordance with the collective agreement, plus night shift supplements.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Then send your application today, we look forward to hearing from you.

Software System Engineer (1-year maternity cover)

Are you ready to lead software system engineering in a high-impact digital health project?

Coloplast has launched the world’s first ostomy leakage notification system – an innovative digital health solution that is already making a meaningful difference for our users.

We are looking for an experienced Software System Engineer to join our Digital Health team as a 1-year maternity cover, helping to evolve this breakthrough product and ensure it remains reliable, secure, and ready for the future.

Join our Digital Health team – a part of R&D

At our HQ in Humlebæk, you will join our Digital Health team, part of Chronic Care R&D. More than 20 engineers, architects, data scientists and product specialists work here in an agile environment on Coloplast’s pioneering digital platform. Here, you will collaborate closely with a highly skilled, senior team that brings deep technical expertise to the table.

We work in a hybrid setup, spending three days a week together at the office. It gives us the best of both worlds: time to collaborate, challenge ideas and co-create in person – balanced with flexibility and focus when working remotely.

Lead software system design in a regulated environment

As our Software System Engineer, you will play a key role in the ongoing evolution of Coloplast’s app software – the digital backbone of our innovative ostomy leakage notification system – you can read more about Heylo here: https://www.coloplastcharter.co.uk/heylo/.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to ensuring continued quality, reliability, scalability, and compliance while enabling new features and enhancements that deliver value to users. You will help drive continuous improvement across requirements, documentation, development processes, and testing, ensuring a strong foundation for future innovation.

You will act as the bridge between stakeholders, technical specialists and regulatory requirements, translating needs into clear, testable and traceable design specifications; your experience with design control and risk management will enable you to be a trusted partner across departments.

You will, for example:

• Run workshops, interviews and analyses with Product Management to understand and refine stakeholder needs and requirements

• Define, manage and trace software requirements using Specification by Example and Gherkin, ensuring full alignment with automated testing

• Lead software risk management and collaborate on cybersecurity with the Software Architect and Technical Solution Owner

• Support with structuring and optimising design control documentation in close collaboration with QA and RA, supporting continuous improvement and audit readiness

• Support with improvements to the integration of automated documentation workflows across the development process

You may also expect 6-10 travel days per year, depending on project needs.

Bring strong documentation and systems thinking

With your proven experience in Agile medtech development, you are confident working with system design, software risk, and compliance. Your structured mindset helps create clarity in complex environments.

You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and enjoy working as part of a passionate and highly skilled team.

In addition, we imagine you:

• Have 3+ years of experience with system engineering within SaMD or medical software development

• Are experienced in authoring and reviewing software design documentation

• Are familiar with IEC/EN 62304, ISO13485 and design control

• Have worked with software verification and risk management processes

• Understand cybersecurity within medical software contexts

Interested?

If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Digital Health, Megan Dyton, at dkmegdyt@coloplast.com. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Are you ready to play a key role in driving commercial growth with business customers? Do you thrive on identifying growth opportunities, setting priorities and translating commercial ambitions into measurable business impact? And do you have experience working in a B2B, advisor-led or account-driven environment? If so, we have a unique opportunity as our new Senior Commercial Planner.

Help shape how technology and AI create value for Danske Bank. Technology and AI are increasingly shaping how Danske Bank delivers value to customers, supports colleagues and executes on its strategic ambitions. As our new experienced Strategy Consultant, you will help senior leaders navigate complex choices by providing perspectives, analyses and recommendations that support both current priorities and future strategic ambitions.

Join a newly established team transforming how Danske Bank communicates with customers. As Chief Business Consultant, you will shape our digital transformation agenda, improve customer experience, and reduce communication costs through data-driven insights and strategic execution.

Company Profile

Light means life and quality of life. Our employees in 50 countries are committed to making light better, more efficient, and more beautiful. Our corporate culture, rooted in the OSRAM tradition, is characterized by strong team spirit, initiative, and entrepreneurial freedom. This is a time full of opportunities. Are you ready to join us on this exciting journey? Then apply now!

Your tasks

• 
Manage and coordinate financial operations, including monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities in collaboration with Shared Service Providers and Group Finance

• 
Ensure compliance with accounting, tax, and statutory requirements, including the preparation and coordination of VAT and tax filings

• 
Oversee Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes and support local treasury and banking activities

• 
Serve as the main point of contact for auditors, authorities, and internal stakeholders, providing support during audits and compliance reviews

• 
Coordinate end-to-end HR administration, including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, and employee lifecycle processes

• 
Partner with Global HR and external payroll providers to support employee administration, talent development, and annual HR processes

• 
Oversee office operations and facilities management

• 
Drive process improvement initiatives, maintain accurate documentation, and support the implementation of new systems and tools

• 
Provide administrative, financial, and operational support to local management, contributing to business performance and organizational objectives

Your Competences

• 
Several years of experience in finance, administration, accounting, HR administration or a similar role

• 
Experience with accounting processes and financial administration

• 
Knowledge of Danish VAT, tax reporting and local legislation

• 
Experience coordinating external service providers and stakeholders

• 
Experience working in an international organization is considered an advantage

• 
Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel

• 
Experience working with SAP, minimum 5 years

• 
Experience working with HR / payroll related systems

• 
Fluent in Danish, both written and spoken

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

• 
Additional qualifications within payroll, tax or HR administration are considered an advantage

Our benefits

• 
Flexible work schedules and 25 days of vacation and five additional vacation days per year

• 
Comprehensive onboarding and plenty of creative freedom

• 
Professional structures, open communication, and collaboration as equals

• 
A well-rounded and varied role in a dynamic company

• 
We offer a canteen scheme ("kantineordning") and free fruit at work

• 
We offer company-paid home internet, company-provided mobile phone

The position

Job overall purpose

• 
The Engineering Excellence Manager, reporting to the Head of Engineering, centralises all Engineering support functions to ensure excellence is intrinsically built into how Engineering operates across a global and evolving, multi-site Engineering environment, from mission and satellite system design to satellite operations

• 
The role establishes and runs the Engineering operating model, ensuring Engineering functions as a well-run, business-centric system that converts engineering effort into delivered mission and satellite capability in a predictable, efficient, and scalable manner

• 
This is a highly operational role, combining broad system responsibility with strong execution, reporting, and follow-up

Key areas of responsibility & tasks

Engineering Operating Model

• 
Centralise and run Engineering support functions within Satellite Systems Engineering, aligned with the Satellite Systems Business Unit, across multiple Engineering sites

• 
Ensure Engineering operates as a well-run, predictable, and business-centric system, optimising internal flow and interfaces to PMO, AIV (manufacturing, integration and verification), procurement, Product production, and other Business Units

• 
Apply system-level and value-stream thinking to consistently convert technical intent into delivered mission and satellite capability

Methods

• 
Define and deploy Engineering methods and standard ways of working.

• 
Enable effective use of AI in both engineering design (what we build) and engineering methods, processes, and operations (how we work)

• 
Drive adoption of DFMAT and modularity principles with a strong focus on practical application and measurable impact

Configuration Management & Interfaces

• 
Establish and own Engineering Configuration Management as a technical discipline, including baselines, interfaces, change control, and traceability, aligned with projects, PMO governance, and company-wide Configuration Management plan

• 
Own and maintain the structure and lifecycle of technical orders towards procurement and Product production for internal and third-party products, ensuring technical clarity, readiness, and alignment with PMO and delivery needs

• 
Ensure clear and efficient technical handovers to AIV in alignment with AIV requirements, integration needs, and execution constraints.

• 
Support and streamline inter-Business Unit interfaces including technical agreements, in alignment with PMO

Compliance

• 
Ensure Engineering compliance with space and quality regulations, protocols, standards, and relevant certifications (e.g. ISO, NIS2), embedding compliance into Engineering processes, tools, and daily practices in coordination with company-wide quality and assurance functions

• 
Own and maintain Engineering assets and tools, including laboratories, test infrastructure, engineering environments, shared engineering toolchains, and licences

Leadership Support & Execution

• 
Act as custodian of the Satellite Systems Business Unit roadmap artefact, ensuring clear structure, visualisation, consistency, and alignment with inputs from the Head of Engineering and technical leaders

• 
Act as Chief of Staff to the Head of Engineering, providing direct support across synthesis, preparation, coordination, and sustained follow-up of complex topics and leadership decisions, ensuring Engineering operates coherently as a system

• 
Establish dashboards, reporting, and operational cadence, and prepare clear, executive-level material for internal and external forums.

• 
Drive execution by ensuring initiatives are implemented, adopted, measured, and continuously improved

• 
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Engineering Excellence team, defining roles, priorities, and ways of working, and scaling the function as the company and Engineering grows

Criteria of Success

• 
High quality and On-time deliveries

• 
Successful projects

• 
High level of engagement in the team

• 
Good relationships with stakeholders

• 
Strategic and technical leadership

Qualifications

Critical experience

• 
Substantial experience in engineering enablement, operational excellence, or equivalent technical operations roles in high-technology environments

• 
Demonstrated ability to design and optimise end-to-end engineering value streams, balancing technical excellence with business outcomes

• 
Experience operating at system and leadership level in complex organisations, exercising judgement, prioritisation, and trade-off decisions under ambiguity

Skills

• 
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent qualificationSound business acumen, translating strategic intent into operational systems and day-to-day execution

• 
Highly operational mindset, with a track record of handling broad responsibility while driving concrete outcomes, follow-up, and measurable results

• 
Strong capability in reporting, including the definition and use of dashboards, metrics, and indicators to steer operations and decision-making

• 
Leadership presence and interpersonal effectiveness, with the capacity to influence without direct authority and operate credibly across functions

• 
Outstanding alignment with GomSpace values: Helpfulness, Open and frequent communication, True leadership, and Acting for customer value

• 
Strong commercial instinct: understands how to win without compromising delivery

• 
Very good communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Sales, Engineering leadership, and customers through clear technical judgement

• 
Proud of your work – including the work of your team

• 
Thrilled for creating business value

• 
Structured

• 
Strategic and innovation driven mindset

• 
Active or eligible for security clearance

• 
English on a high level – oral and written

Education

• 
Relevant degree in Engineering (Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field)

Contact and location

The company doesn't become aware of your inquiry without your acceptance. If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jan Tornfeldt via jt@matchmaker.dk or phone +45 29 99 90 40

The company

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, show true leadership and act for customer value.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Our mission: “We make Space Yours”

From our first CubeSat innovations to enabling entire constellations, we’ve been driven by one mission: to empower nations, businesses, researchers, and visionaries to claim their place in space.
With cutting-edge small satellite technology, we break down barriers – making access to space smarter, faster, and more affordable.
Today, we’re not just building satellites – we’re building opportunities. We’re not just enabling missions – we’re enabling dreams by helping and guiding our customers in fulfilling their space ambitions. Whether you’re a startup launching your first satellite, an ambitious government deploying national strengths or an established enterprise building a global network “We make space Yours. Accessible, Affordable, Useful.

It’s YOURS to explore, YOURS to innovate, and YOURS to reach.

With more than 19 years of experience in the market and a track record of multiple successful missions accomplished, we have developed profound knowledge and competencies within Radio Technology, Cubesat Platforms, Project Management as well as Innovation. We provide the solutions that enables our customers to succeed in their business - whether this is a product, a subsystem, support or a full customized solution. We deliver these projects based on our strong in-house portfolios of established products and rich capabilities.

GOMSpace is organized as five Business Units managed by a VP. This job is in the SATSYS Business Unit and is reporting to the Head of Engineering in SATSYS Business Unit. GomSpaces’ headquarter is in Aalborg, Denmark and due to the leadership responsibility in this role, the job is placed at the HQ. So you will have to relocate to the HQ in Denmark and GomSpace provides support for the relocation.

In short GomSpace is

• 
An innovative and international listed company headquartered in Aalborg

• 
International in the daily working style - English is the corporate language

• 
Growing, there are a lot of big projects kicking off, it’s an exciting time to join

• 
Flexible. We constantly challenge what works best for the teams – the project management is based on internationally recognised standards and teamorientated approaches

• 
Customer focused: We have respect for our customers

• 
People focus: We believe success is all about “people and culture”

In this Staff Software Engineering role, you’ll be…

• 
Responsible for the full product development end-to-end.

• 
A technical lighthouse, defining architecture, balancing business needs with long-term technical health, and coordinating with other engineers to move how we do engineering forward.

• 
Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape the solution to the problem and oversee technical implementations from end to end.

• 
A leader and mentor without direct people management. Continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are in your DNA, as you challenge the status quo, unblock engineers across the organisation, and mentor senior team members to help them achieve greater impact.

Who is the GRC Infrastructure Team?

The GRC Infrastructure team is the core team of our Formalize product, which works on our strategic mission to build the flexible and secure engine that powers our entire Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform.

Here, the team designs, builds, and maintains the foundational modules to support our customers in their GRC needs.

Essentially, we build things from an infrastructure-first principle, where we solve specific GRC problems with generic and flexible modules to allow our customers to shape our software to their specific needs.

Our tech stack:

• 
PHP with Laravel

• 
Angular 22

• 
TailwindCSS

• 
PostgreSQL

• 
Redis for caching

• 
Claude Code

• 
Serverless infrastructure on AWS

Not an expert in our entire stack? No problem. At Formalize, we value curiosity and a willingness to learn. With solid fundamentals and the right mindset, we will help you grow the rest.

What you’ll bring:

• 
Expert knowledge in at least one layer of our technical stack (we work with PHP and Angular), as well as general software architecture and system design.

• 
Demonstrated staff experience in a Software Engineering role, designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable systems in production, end-to-end.

• 
Experience in product development with a focus on quality and value delivery.

• 
The ability to clearly define technical direction for systems and lead deep architectural and software design sessions.

• 
Good engineering practices for testing, deployment, & observability paired with the ability to communicate strategic trade-offs clearly, mentor senior colleagues, and increase impact across the organisation.

• 
The ability to raise the bar for engineering quality and performance through reference implementations and by defining ever-evolving code standards.

We offer you:

• 
A starting salary of 79,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 89,000 DKK per month.

• 
Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• 
Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.

• 
An office-first culture in a centrally located office, along with visa support if needed.

• 
A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• 
A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• 
Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

Our recruitment process:

• 
Send your application and upload relevant information.

• 
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.

• 
30-minute online interview with the Hiring Manager.

• 
Completion of Personality Assessment & 1h Technical Assessment.

• A collaborative no-coding session where we work through building a real feature in Formalize: clarifying requirements, data modelling, and walking through pseudo-code together.

• 
30-minute walkthrough of our career framework and offer details.

• 
60-minute in-person interview to meet the team.

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid and Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from 19 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

About the position

Solvexis Consult is looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor for a construction project in Fredericia.

You will be responsible for supervising and coordinating electrical and instrumentation activities on site, ensuring that installations are completed safely, correctly and according to the agreed schedule and quality requirements.

The position requires close cooperation with contractors, subcontractors, engineering partners, the commissioning team and the client.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• 
Supervising electrical and instrumentation installation activities on site.

• 
Coordinating the daily work of electrical contractors and subcontractors.

• 
Participating in project, coordination and progress meetings with the general contractor, subcontractors and client.

• 
Monitoring installation progress and identifying delays, technical constraints and supply-chain challenges.

• 
Supporting the contract-management process, including progress evaluation, change orders and potential commercial impacts.

• 
Providing technical E&I support and working closely with the client’s commissioning team.

• 
Inspecting the installation and testing of LV distribution panels, DCS panels, BMS panels, solenoid panels and associated electrical equipment.

• 
Ensuring that drawings, documentation and other project deliverables are provided on time.

• 
Reviewing installation and testing schedules and reporting issues or risks to the relevant project leads.

• 
Coordinating the safe execution of energisation and LOTO activities in accordance with project procedures and required authorizations.

• 
Conducting QA walk downs and identifying quality issues, incomplete work and deviations.

• 
Coordinating and supporting punch-list close-out before and after mechanical completion.

• 
Ensuring that work is carried out in accordance with project HSE requirements, quality standards and approved procedures.

• 
Maintaining clear progress records and communicating status, risks and required actions to project stakeholders.

Qualifications and experience

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant electrical qualification, such as electrician, electrical technician, electrical engineer or equivalent.

• 
Proven experience supervising electrical installations on construction or industrial projects.

• 
Practical knowledge of LV installations, electrical testing, energisation and LOTO procedures.

• 
Experience working with electrical panels and control systems.

• 
The ability to read and understand electrical drawings, schematics, specifications and project documentation.

• 
Experience with QA inspections, walk downs, punch lists and system handover.

• 
Strong coordination and communication skills.

• 
A structured and safety-conscious approach to your work.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

Experience with DCS and BMS installations, commissioning activities or large multidisciplinary projects will be an advantage.

What we offer

At Solvexis, you will be supported by a professional organization throughout your assignment. We provide structured onboarding, administrative support, documentation assistance and regular follow-up, allowing you to focus on delivering high-quality work for the project.

You will join a technically demanding project with close cooperation across contractors, engineering, commissioning and client teams.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.

About ViroGates

ViroGates A/S is a Danish in-vitro diagnostics company listed on Nasdaq First North Growth Market Copenhagen. The company’s mission is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention through high-accuracy diagnostic tools that enable earlier intervention and better decision-making.

ViroGates’ proprietary suPARnostic® product portfolio is based on the suPAR biomarker, providing clinically validated insights into chronic inflammation and overall health risk. The technology is used across acute care and clinical triage, with a growing focus on preventive health, longevity, and wellness.

Executive Summary

ViroGates A/S is seeking a Product-/QA Specialist to combine product management of its suPARnostic® portfolio with management of the company's quality management system as the company scales. The role suits an experienced IVD or medical device professional who can balance speed of execution with regulatory rigour while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.

Key Responsibilities

Product Management

• Drive product management of new and existing suPARnostic® products, including leading R&D projects and improving existing products

• Maintain technical product documentation, including IFUs

• Act as the primary contact to the contract manufacturer

• Provide product‐related sales support and customer training, and forecast consumables

Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance

• Act as ViroGates’ Co-Management Representative and process owner for the quality management system

• Maintain and continuously improve the QMS in line with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements (IVDR)

• Control of documents and records

• Plan, conduct and support internal and external audits

• Verify and oversee product storage and shipping/transport conditions (temperature monitoring, deviation/excursion handling, review of transport and storage stability data)

Risk, Vigilance & Post-market Surveillance

• Risk management and change control

• Handle nonconformities, CAPAs and complaints, including review and trending

• Manage vigilance and reporting to authorities

• Post‐market surveillance and related processes

Management Reviews, Training & Supplier Quality

• Prepare and participate in management reviews

• Own training processes across the organisation

• Manage supplier quality

• Contribute to management reporting on quality and product performance

Candidate Profile

Experience & Expertise

• Relevant degree within life sciences, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, bioanalytical or a similar field

• Minimum 5 years’ experience from the IVD or medical device industry, including product management and/or R&D

• Documented experience as a QA Specialist / Management Representative and solid working knowledge of ISO 13485 and IVDR

• Hands‐on experience with core QMS processes (document control, audits, CAPA, complaints, risk management and post‐market surveillance) and with technical product documentation and IFUs

• Strong cross‐functional collaboration skills

Personal Attributes

• Structured, detail‐oriented and quality‐minded

• Able to balance speed of execution with regulatory compliance

• Pragmatic and hands‐on, comfortable operating in a lean, fast‐moving organisation

• Able to work across R&D, Sales & Marketing and external partners

Practical Requirements

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); Danish is an advantage

• Based at or able to work from ViroGates’ HQ in Birkerød

• Willingness to travel up to 15 days per year

Organisation & Ways of Working

ViroGates operates with a lean organisation and a small, engaged team; the role reports directly to the QA & Product Manager. The culture is characterised by constructive collaboration, open dialogue and a strong focus on execution discipline. This role suits someone who enjoys end-to-end ownership rather than a narrow, siloed function.

Why Join ViroGates

• Opportunity to work with both product and quality for a differentiated biomarker platform with strong clinical validation and multiple commercial applications

• High degree of influence relative to organisation size, with direct access to management and decision‐making

• A pivotal, cross‐functional role at a listed diagnostics company entering the fast‐growing longevity and preventive health markets

• Collaborative, non‐hierarchical working environment with an entrepreneurial mindset

jobs.description:
About Monta

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you’ll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You’ll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on individual contributor role where you'll own delivery of meaningful pieces of our financial systems and grow your expertise in the domain, helping us scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes ownership of what they build. You'll own medium-sized projects from design through to production, working independently within your team and delivering quality outcomes.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• 
Help rebuild Monta's financial backbone. You'll contribute to the new invoicing system that every customer will use, owning meaningful slices of the new infrastructure.

• 
Power EU expansion. You'll build features within our compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• 
Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You’ll Do

• 
Deliver core parts of the new invoice system. Build features within the new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows, owning your slice end-to-end and contributing to design discussions.

• 
Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• 
Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• 
Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• 
Build for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll write code with auditability, correctness, and scale in mind, and contribute to design discussions for new components.

• 
Grow with the team. Contribute through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing, and help onboard new joiners as you grow into the domain.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Solid backend engineering experience. You've built and shipped production systems and you write clean, maintainable code. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• 
Some exposure to financial systems is a plus. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness matters — but we'll help you grow the depth.

• 
A sense of ownership. You take responsibility for what you ship, follow it through to production, and flag issues early rather than waiting to be asked.

• 
Comfortable asking questions and learning fast. Regulatory and financial domains have a lot of nuance — you bring curiosity and a willingness to dig in.

• 
Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• 
Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• 
Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus:

• 
Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• 
Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• 
Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

AI at Monta Engineering

AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

Tools we use daily:

• 
Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• 
Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• 
Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• 
AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• 
Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you’ll feel it every day.

• 
Ownership from day one — we don’t micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• 
The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You’ll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure

What We Offer

• 
A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• 
A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• 
Free lunch every day.

• 
Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• 
Paid parental leave to support life’s big moments.

• 
Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• 
Flexible working hours; as long as you’re at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you’ll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don’t accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won’t agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

Monta is the operating platform powering the EV charging ecosystem serving drivers, companies, cities, and the electricity grid with one integrated software solution. We believe that accelerating and democratising the adoption of EV technology is key to building a better future. Monta’s mission is to provide the best technology solutions for the entire EV charging cycle. At our core, we provide access, innovation, and reliability to the mobility transformation. We're here to make the transition to electric mobility as seamless and exciting as possible. With a single integrated software built to EV better. Founded in 2020 our team has been growing fast and are now more than 200 employees with 47 different nationalities. Our HQ is based in Copenhagen, and we have offices in Oslo, Berlin, Paris, London and just opened Barcelona. Our culture is based on trust, transparency, and respect, where everyone contributes to making Monta what it is. You don't have to work 9-17, we trust our people to know how they work best. We empower each team to choose how and when they work. Inclusion is also a big part of our culture, and we make sure that everybody feels welcome, heard and able to bring all of who they are to work. We take it upon ourselves to protect this space that has allowed us to get this far. Monta is dedicated to encouraging a supportive, diverse and inclusive culture amongst all Monteers as they are fundamental to our values as a company. One of the best things about Monta is our people. Right from the get-go you will feel how inclusive, diverse, sociable and friendly our team is. We go to the office as much as possible, not because we have to, but because we enjoy each other's company - even outside work hours we hang out together. We have lots of different clubs you can join, there's a chess club, a ski club, (there's a slack channel for every little interest we can bond over). Everyone is very passionate about what we do and invested in the product and their role. We are a team of innovators, experts, and “bar-setters” in our fields. We believe that we can create the path needed to sustainably scale the industry towards the future. We're biased toward action, so we're always looking for ways to improve and make things work for many, not just few. We don't just want to be good at what we do—we want to be the best at it. Better results, better technology, better systems, better together. The combination of all this, and the feeling that we are contributing something great to the world, gives everyone a strong sense of belonging and makes our employees and customers want to work with us - it helps our company thrive. Everyone here is proud to be a 'Monteer'. If you’d like to work in a green, tech-driven company and are passionate about innovation, we might be the right fit! We've got an incredible team, and hope to find more peers who can help us push things even further.
